newsitem.title: UK: N.Sea Nelson woes impact on Forties unclear - trade.
newsitem.headline: N.Sea Nelson woes impact on Forties unclear - trade.

text.p: The effect on Forties loading programmes of lost production at the North Sea Nelson field is not yet clear, traders said on Thursday.

Sources at Enterprise Oil, operators of the Nelson platform, said output had fallen by 20,000 barrels per day to 120,000 bpd because of problems with a gas system. Production could fall as low as 50,000 bpd this week.
While it was clear the lost output would affect loading programmes in July, the details were not yet clear, the sources said. Nelson feeds into the Forties pipeline system.
"No decision has been taken yet, there is consultation taking place to see what adjustments (to the programme) have to be made," said a trader.
"Obviously if barrels are not being produced then things will have to be cut or deferred but the co-ordinators are still talking," he added.
Nelson, in the British sector of the North Sea, suffered production disruption earlier this year when it had to lower output to 53,000 bpd in June to allow repairs to a faulty gas compressor.
It returned to full capacity in late June
